findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - a new or upgraded client approves a small change to an existing screen. Both parameterized cases call setup(repo), whose default is kind="forge-source" and which overwrites forge.toml (tests/test_story.py:137–141). This also replaces the adopted fixture's client configuration, so neither case tests the client admission contract claimed in the proof list. The existing Design:none context test makes every task backend-only (tests/test_design_context.py:85–86), bypassing that admission rule. Exercise the reason refusal and successful read, approval and task start on actual new and earlier-adopted client configurations, as the review rules require.
findings.title: Gate: test_1_small_screen_changes_need_a_reason_instead_of_a_canvas
